node.statement: Transverse-moment demand (one unit of D-moment). Instantiating the coordinate-reproduction identity of the previous step at the row i = z, and using x_z = 1 from the actor coordinates, the z-row must carry exactly one unit of transverse (D-direction) moment: sum_j P_{zj}·x_j = x_z = 1, with the coefficients (P_{zj}) summing to 1 and having total negative mass at most t.
